name: i.safe MOBILE IS930.1
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS930.1 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ib) 8-inch Android tablet from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX, IECEx and UKEX. It runs Android 14.

otherSchemes: EAC, KCs (Korea), INMETRO (Brazil), Japan-Ex, IA (South Africa), PESO (India), TELEC

atex.marking: II 2G Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db IP6X
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0 (2019-12-20), checked 2026-10-25. ATEX and UKEX numbers taken from the EU/UK DoC 1030CC13REV00 (2022-09-29); certificate PDFs not read.

iecex.marking: Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db IP6X

certification.northAmerica: NEC 500: Class I Div 1 Groups A, B, C, D T4; Class II Div 1 Groups E, F, G T135°C; Class III Div 1

safety.conditions: IECEx X conditions: battery may be charged outside explosion hazardous areas only; protect against permanent UV light and high electrostatic charge processes; permitted ambient temperature −20 °C to +60 °C. Safety instructions: all interface covers closed in Ex areas; charging only outside Ex areas (+5 to +35 °C); battery not interchangeable.
safety.peripherals: Opening any interface or connector cover in an Ex area is not permitted. Wired data connection and charging only outside Ex areas (docking station IS-DS930.1, i.safe PROTECTOR cables). A commercial microSD card may be used in its slot in the Ex area (IECEx text).
safety.certifiedAccessories: Maker page lists: IS-DS930.1 docking station set (RJ45, 3 x USB), IS-MC930.1 six-bay multi charger, i.safe PROTECTOR 2.0 / 3.0 USB-C cables, leather case with shoulder/belt/carry straps, vehicle mount. Charging and cable accessories are for use outside Ex areas. Which accessories are Ex-rated for use inside Ex areas is not stated for IS930.1.

specs.display: 8-inch Glove-usable touch display; Corning Gorilla Glass V3 stated on the IS930.M1 page (not on the IS930.1 page)
specs.ports: USB-C; 24-pin docking interface; magnetic charger port; earphone jack; microSD slot; micro-SIM
specs.docking: Office dock IS-DS930.1 (RJ45, 3 x USB); IS-MC930.1 six-bay multi charger; vehicle mount
specs.gnss: GPS, A-GPS, Glonass, Beidou (Galileo added on IS930.M1 page)
specs.keys: SOS key (red); two freely programmable keys
specs.touch: Usable with gloves (maker); wet-touch not stated
specs.partNumbers: Model M93A01 (DoC); article numbers not published on maker page
